optimized032.environment: Chromium SwiftShader software rendering; 1280x720, moving physics, GPU readPixels synchronization; not hardware FPS

notes: Software Chromium results only. readPixels forces GPU completion and includes synchronization overhead; do not interpret as real-device FPS.
Same 1280x720 viewport, physical motion, 5 warmup and 24 sampled frames. Default modes: old effects-on vs new automatic at scale 1.
Simulation code is byte-for-byte unchanged. Physics timing difference is measurement noise.
Triangle/draw counters include beauty and shadow passes. Shadows update at 30 Hz in the optimized version.
